_comment: Editable normalisation rules for free-text ENA metadata. Nothing here infers a
value that a submitter did not record: these rules only recognise explicit null
placeholders and group verbatim specimen strings into coarse categories.
Review and extend these lists for your own study, and document any change.
_facility_comment: Values that name a collection facility rather than a country. ENA submitters
sometimes place these in the country field. They are NOT recoded to a country
here, because doing so would be an inference rather than a recorded fact; they
are moved to collection_site and country_clean is left blank. The listed
facilities are all KwaZulu-Natal (South Africa) TB hospitals and clinics, so
they can be recoded to South Africa once you have verified this against the
_specimen_comment: Maps verbatim isolation_source strings to a coarse specimen category usable as
the 'infection site' clinical feature. Strings that describe no anatomical site
which is a recorded non-answer and must not be read as pulmonary.
